role: Housekeeping floor supervisor reviewing each completed room turnover before the room is released back to sale
setting: A mid-size city hotel where every checkout room passes through a turnover record: attendant cleaning steps, supervisor inspection, linen and minibar counts, maintenance work orders and the next booked arrival. The supervisor reviews one turnover record at a time at a stated review timestamp and decides whether the room can be released, needs a recheck, or must come off sale.

bed_setup_match.instructions: Prepared bed setup matches what the next booked arrival requires.

criteria.true: Bed type, count and cot match the arrival booking.
criteria.false: Any bed or cot difference, or no arrival data.

blocking_defect.instructions: An open maintenance defect prevents the room being sold tonight.

room_disposition.instructions: What status should the room be given after this review?

criteria.release_inspected: All checks pass; release room to sale as inspected.
criteria.release_followup: Guest-ready now; non-blocking gap logged for later correction.
criteria.hold_recheck: Keep off sale until one recheck or confirmation is logged.
criteria.out_of_order: Remove from sale until an unresolved defect is repaired.

arrival_slack.instructions: How much time remains before the next guest is due?
criteria: Overdue: arrival time already passed, room not yet released
Tight: under 60 minutes until expected arrival
Moderate: 60 to 240 minutes until expected arrival
Ample: over 240 minutes, or no arrival booked

open_items.instructions: How many required items on this record remain unresolved?
criteria: One or two required items remain unresolved
Three to five required items remain unresolved
Six or more required items remain unresolved

factors.name: checklist_completion
factors.description: How many attendant checklist steps are marked done; partial means one or several steps left with done=false or null timestamp

factors.name: step_order_anomaly
factors.description: Inspection start timestamp precedes the attendant clean end timestamp, showing inspection logged before cleaning finished

factors.name: bed_config_mismatch
factors.description: Difference between beds made up in turnover and bed type, guest count or cot request in the arrival booking

factors.name: arrival_info_present
factors.description: Whether the next arrival section is populated; when false it is null, leaving bed match unverifiable and slack contested

factors.name: arrival_slack_minutes
factors.description: Minutes between review timestamp and arrival eta; negative means arrival time already passed

factors.name: linen_count_gap
factors.description: Difference between linen pieces issued for the room and soiled pieces returned to laundry

factors.name: minibar_mismatch
factors.description: Disagreement between minibar items consumed, items posted to folio and items restocked

factors.name: maintenance_defect
factors.description: Severity of the most serious defect noted by attendant or inspector and linked work order

factors.name: defect_mitigated
factors.description: Whether the defect's work order shows a closed status with engineer sign-off or a logged temporary fix

factors.name: inspection_fail_pending
factors.description: Inspector failed at least one item and the re-clean or recheck entry is not yet logged

factors.name: pms_status_mismatch
factors.description: Room status in the property system differs from housekeeping status implied by turnover and inspection timestamps

factors.name: priority_flag_decoy
factors.description: VIP or early check-in flag on the arrival, which raises apparent urgency but does not change the slack minutes

sections.name: room
sections.description: room_no, room_type, floor, pms_status, review_at timestamp

sections.name: arrival
sections.description: next booking: booking_ref, eta, adults, children, bed_pref, cot_req, flags; null when unavailable

sections.name: turnover
sections.description: attendant_id, clean_start, clean_end, checklist list of step, done, done_at; beds_made list of bed type and cot

sections.name: inspection
sections.description: inspector_id, insp_start, insp_end, items list of area, result, recheck_at

sections.name: supplies
sections.description: linen issued and returned counts by item; minibar consumed, posted and restocked counts by sku

sections.name: maintenance
sections.description: work_orders list of wo_id, area, category, opened_at, status, closed_at, signoff, temp_fix

rendering_notes: checklist_completion shows as turnover.checklist entries with done=false or done_at null. step_order_anomaly shows only by comparing inspection.insp_start with turnover.clean_end. bed_config_mismatch appears by comparing turnover.beds_made with arrival.bed_pref, adults+children and cot_req; never flagged. arrival_info_present=false renders arrival as null. arrival_slack_minutes is derived as arrival.eta minus room.review_at; no slack field exists. linen_count_gap appears as differing supplies.linen issued vs returned counts per item; small gaps of 1 are decoys that rarely matter. minibar_mismatch is spread across consumed, posted and restocked counts for the same sku. maintenance_defect appears as work_orders.category (e.g. paint_scuff, tv_remote, no_hot_water, smoke_detector) and inspection items with result=fail; defect_mitigated shows as status=closed with signoff, or temp_fix=true, independent of severity. inspection_fail_pending is an item with result=fail and recheck_at null. pms_status_mismatch shows as room.pms_status (e.g. VI or OOO) inconsistent with timestamps. priority_flag_decoy appears in arrival.flags as vip or early_ci. Records never contain fields stating readiness, risk, disposition, slack band or whether a defect blocks sale; pms_status is a real system code and may itself be wrong. Timestamps ISO 8601, counts as integers, unknowns null.
